summary: Lewis Hamilton faces redemption at the Circuit of the Americas after his Singapore blunder hands Kimi Antonelli a golden opportunity to clinch the world championship in Texas. Ferrari's young sensation needs just one more podium finish to mathematically secure the title, while Hamilton hunts for redemption and a potential upset against his former team's momentum. A coronation in Austin would mark Antonelli as the sport's newest champion and cement Ferrari's resurgence, or delay the inevitable and ignite a tense final stretch of the season.
